verdict.rationale: The pack shows that Puzzle supports class groupings ("unlimited number of Groups for Classes") and offers one-click financial reports and statement exports. Nothing documents a custom report builder, or reports filtered or grouped by class, location, or tag. Class setup is an adjacent classification feature, not the reporting capability the story asks for, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can build custom reports filtered and grouped by class, location, or tag dimensions
